items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: it was the used bus that Jack Crawford was turning in

ctx.x: But before that time, before that bus, it was really comical. We were travelling in those cars and Jack Crawford, white band, had a bus that looked like the old stagecoaches, like something on top, like a caboose, and I'd been kind of working around and trying to get a bus and the Chevy Company, they had ordered a brand new bus for Jack Crawford and I went in

and had been talking around with him, so when Jack got this, some salesman called me, Fields, I have a good bus here, we'll make you a good deal on it, a used bus, and I went and saw it. I went with a few of the boys and we said, this is ridiculous to go down the road in. So we got to thinking it would be better than the car, than piling in the car. So, we got the bus, it was so cheap that I paid cash for the bus; it was the used bus that Jack Crawford was turning in. I don't know if I ever saw anything that…
Anyway, we drove around for about a season, I guess, and one time, we were coming-- some of the boys would drive and I would drive
